Antioxidants are molecules that help protect cells from damage caused by unstable molecules known as free radicals. Free radicals can build up in the body and cause oxidative stress, which is linked to various chronic diseases and the aging process. By neutralizing these free radicals, antioxidants offer several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, supporting the immune system, lowering the risk of chronic conditions such as heart disease and certain cancers, and promoting overall cellular health and longevity.

The transparent material used to make windows is glass.
